wa: Hello Valorin, I saw your video on ERP customisation and would like to talk about our ERP changes.
linkedin:
A change request lands on the ERP team because a process is messy. In our view, custom code is rarely the fix.

Customising around a broken process makes it faster and harder to change. Fix the process first, then configure the system.

Before any change request, we'd ask three questions:
• Why do we do this step at all?
• Can standard settings already do it?
• Who maintains it after go-live?

How many custom changes does your ERP carry today?
